text: The Nokia 2 is a budget Android smartphone manufactured by HMD Global under the Nokia brand, announced on 31 October 2017. It features a 5.0-inch LTPS IPS LCD display, a quad-core 1.3 GHz Cortex-A7 Qualcomm Snapdragon 212 processor, 1 GB of RAM, and 8 GB of internal storage that can be expanded via microSD cards up to 128 GB. The device is equipped with a 4100 mAh battery, offering a claimed two-day battery life. It includes an 8 MP rear camera with LED flash and a 5 MP front-facing camera, available in pewter and black, pewter and white, and copper and black colour options. The phone launched with Android 7.1.1 Nougat and can be upgraded to Android 8.1 Oreo; however, in June 2019, HMD Global announced it would not receive an update to Android 9 Pie due to the System-on-Chip's insufficient performance. Reviews of the Nokia 2 were mixed, with Andrew Williams of TechRadar commending its battery life and pricing, while criticizing its slow performance, poor cameras, and limited storage.
